questions.question: Why was Ogi Zenin passed over for the head of the Zenin clan?
questions.subject: Ogi Zenin/Synopsis

answer.item: Due to his daughters lacking talent in jujutsu, he was passed over for the position of the 25th head of the clan by his older brother.

questions.question: What did Naobito Zenin's will reveal about the next clan leader?
questions.subject: Ogi Zenin/Synopsis

answer.item: Ogi listened as Furudate read Naobito's will, which revealed that in the event of Satoru Gojo's disappearance, Megumi Fushiguro was to become the next clan leader.
